reader_summary.headline: This is The Memo by Howard Marks, a look under the hood.
reader_summary.overview: This is The Memo by Howard Marks, a look under the hood. Over the last 56 years, I've spent a lot of time making suggestions to clients regarding their investment processes and portfolios. But seldom have I been able to bridge the two, serving as an active participant in clients' investment processes.

thesis: The speaker describes a meeting with a U.S. State Pension Fund where a consultant used a risk matrix to show that the board has a high ability to bear risk but only a moderate willingness to do so, which constrains returns but avoids exposure to extreme outcomes. The speaker notes that the board explicitly prefers conservative underperformance in strong markets over aggressive strategies that carry higher risks, and they ranked beating peers as the last objective rather than a primary goal.
